name: Ringetsu
source:
A long time ago, the Rindou family was cursed by a monster. Since then, new born babies have been girls. To break the curse, they had to marry girls of the Hizuki family who have strong spiritual power, and have to bear a child by the next red moon. Now, the curse befalls Rindou Naoto. In order to break the curse, he has to beget a child with one of four sisters of the Hizuki.

[Edited from AnimeNfo]
translation:
很久以前，龙胆家受到妖怪诅咒。自那以后，家族新生儿全是女孩。要打破诅咒，他们必须迎娶拥有强大灵力的绯月家女子，并在下一次红月到来前诞下孩子。如今，诅咒降临到龙胆直人身上。为了破解诅咒，他必须与绯月家的四姐妹之一孕育后代。

[编辑自AnimeNfo]
